title: Disinter
summary: DISINTER, verb transitive [dis and inter.] 1. To take out of a grave, or out of the earth; as, to disinter a dead body that is buried. 2. To take out as from a grave; to bring from obscurity into view

inlines.v: DISINTER, verb transitive [dis and inter.] 1. To take out of a grave, or out of the earth; as, to disinter a dead body that is buried. 2. To take out as from a grave; to bring from obscurity into view. The philosopher--may be concealed in a plebeian, which a proper education might have disinterred. [Unusual.]
